steps.description: Load PDDL domain and problem files using unified_planning PDDLReader

suggestions: Use unified_planning.io.PDDLReader().parse_problem(domain_path, problem_path) to load both files.

steps.description: Generate a plan using OneshotPlanner with pyperplan

suggestions: Use OneshotPlanner(name='pyperplan').solve(problem). Check that solve() returns a valid plan before proceeding.

steps.description: Save the validated plan using PDDLWriter in correct PDDL format

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ str(action) produces 'action(args)' format. The verifier requires '(action args)' format. Use PDDLWriter.write_plan() instead.
❌ Manually writing plan files produces wrong PDDL syntax. Use unified_planning.io.PDDLWriter.write_plan() instead.
❌ Do not manually join or write action strings. The PDDLReader expects '(action arg1 arg2)' format — use PDDLWriter.write_plan() to guarantee correct format.

suggestions: Use unified_planning.io.PDDLWriter().write_plan(plan, output_path) — the ONLY safe way to produce '(action args)' format.
The verifier calls PDDLReader.parse_plan() which requires each non-comment line to match the regex: '(action-name param1 ... paramN)'.
warnings: Any line that does not match '(action args)' — including 'action(args)', bare action names, or non-comment text — causes parse_plan() to raise an exception and fail the test.
